brief_rationale: All five responsibility chain items met with doctor-initiated workspace queries, clear medication reconciliation, red flag symptom coverage, follow-up planning, and patient teach-back. Two high-order points completed: HO1 provided low-burden alternatives to reduce travel burden, and HO4 achieved safe bounded closure with clear red flag triggers and residual risk acknowledgment. No responsibility chain errors or important non-chain defects present.
